TERM OF AGREEMENT. This Agreement will take effect on the Effective Date and remain in effect for a period of 1 year; provided, that Sections 2 and 3 level shall terminate promptly upon (a) any action or omission by Client or any of its customers which constitutes a breach of or default by TrueLink under any System Agreement or Credit Repository Agreement, which breach or default has either not been cured or cannot be cured within the applicable cure period and the consequences of which is that TrueLink will lose material rights it had pursuant to said Agreements or (b) any violations or breach by Client of Sections 8a - 8c. This Agreement shall renew automatically thereafter for successive one year periods until terminated pursuant to Section 12 herein or unless either Client or TrueLink deliver to the other written notice of intent not to renew no later than thirty (30) days prior to the end of said year. If Client decides to discontinue its Hosting Service, Client is responsible for arranging for a new name server within 30 days. In case of discontinued Service, Client shall retain full ownership of all domains associated with Client and Client Content. If Client decides to discontinue Hosting Service, Client is responsible for arranging for a new hosting environment within 60 days."},{"id":"p0079","text":"14. TERMINATION. Subject to Section 4 hereof, TrueLink will continue to provide the requested Hosting Services and Support Services until the last day of the month following the month in which Client provides TrueLink with a written notice of its election to terminate this Agreement."},{"id":"p0080","text":"15. ASSIGNMENT OR TRANSFER. Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate."},{"id":"p0081","text":"16. MODIFICATIONS. This Agreement may be amended at any time and from time to time, but any amendment must be in writing and signed by the party to be charged."},{"id":"p0082","text":"17. WAIVER. No waiver of any provision of this Agreement will be valid unless it is in writing and signed by the party against whom it is sought to be enforced. No waiver at any time of any provision of this Agreement will be deemed a waiver of any other provision of this"},{"id":"p0083","text":"-8- 9 Agreement at that time or a waiver of that or any other provision of this Agreement at any other time."},{"id":"p0084","text":"18. UNDEFINED TERMS. Terms that are not specifically defined in this Agreement are used as set forth in the California Uniform Commercial Code."},{"id":"p0085","text":"19. POWER AND AUTHORITY. Each party represents to the other that it has all necessary power and authority to enter into and perform its obligations under this Agreement. The individuals executing this Agreement on behalf of each party represent that they have authority to do so."},{"id":"p0086","text":"20. NOTICES. All notices required or permitted to be sent under this Agreement shall be in writing and shall be sent to the parties at the addresses set forth in the preamble of this Agreement, or to such other addresses and to such other individuals of which either party may notify the other in a notice which complies with the provisions of this subsection. All notices will be deemed given (i) when delivered by hand, (ii) one (l) day after delivery to a reputable overnight carrier, or (iii) three (3) days after placement in first-class mail, postage prepaid, return receipt requested."},{"id":"p0087","text":"21. CUMULATIVE RIGHTS. The rights and remedies of the parties hereunder are cumulative and are in addition to, and not in lieu of, all rights and remedies available at law and in equity."},{"id":"p0088","text":"22. CAPTIONS. The captions in this Agreement are included for convenience of reference only and will not be construed to define or limit any of the provisions contained herein."},{"id":"p0089","text":"23. JOINT DRAFTING AND NEUTRAL CONSTRUCTION. This Agreement is a negotiated document and shall be deemed to have been drafted jointly by the Parties, and no rule of construction or interpretation shall apply against any particular party based on a contention that the Agreement was drafted by one of the Parties including, but not limited to California Civil Code section 1654, the provisions of which are hereby waived. This Agreement shall be construed and interpreted in a neutral manner."},{"id":"p0090","text":"24. VALIDITY OF AGREEMENT. If any term, provision, covenant, or condition of this Agreement is held by a court of competent jurisdiction to be invalid or unenforceable, the rest of the Agreement shall remain in full force and effect and shall in no way be affected or invalidated. The provisions of Sections 1 and 5 through 30 this Agreement will survive the expiration or termination of this Agreement."},{"id":"p0091","text":"25. ENTIRE AGREEMENT. This Agreement, including all Exhibits, contains the entire agreement of the Parties relating to the rights granted and obligations assumed herein. Any oral representations or modifications concerning this instrument shall be of no force or effect unless contained in a subsequent written modification signed by the party to be charged."},{"id":"p0092","text":"-9- 10"},{"id":"p0093","text":"26. APPLICABLE LAW. This Agreement shall be governed, construed and interpreted in accordance with the laws of the State of California (without respect to principles of conflicts of law)."},{"id":"p0094","text":"27. VENUE. Any and all disputes between the parties that cannot be settled by mutual agreement shall be resolved solely and exclusively in the state or federal courts located within San Luis Obispo County, California, and each party consents to the jurisdiction of such courts and irrevocably waives any objections thereto, including without limitation, on the basis of improper venue or forum non conveniens."},{"id":"p0095","text":"28. ATTORNEY FEES AND COSTS. In any action brought under this Agreement, the prevailing party shall be entitled to recover its actual costs and attorney fees pursuant to California Civil Code section 1717 and all other litigation costs, including expert witness fees, and all actual attorney fees and litigation costs incurred in connection with the enforcement of a judgment arising from such action or proceeding. The provisions of the preceding sentence shall be severable from the provisions of this Agreement and shall survive the entry of any such judgment."},{"id":"p0096","text":"29. NO PARTNERSHIP OR JOINT VENTURE. The parties hereto understand and agree that TrueLink is furnishing its services and the Interface to Client on its own behalf and not on behalf of the System providers. Client understands and agrees that authorization to use the System must be obtained from the System providers. In no event will TrueLink offer the Systems without such authorization from the System providers. Nothing contained herein will be construed to create any association, partnership, joint venture or any agency relationship between the parties hereto."},{"id":"p0097","text":"30. FORCE MAJEURE. TrueLink will be excused from delays in performing or from failing to perform its obligations under this Agreement to the extent the delays or failures result from causes beyond the reasonable control or TrueLink. However, to be excused from delay or failure to perform, TrueLink must act diligently to remedy the cause of the delay or failure."},{"id":"p0098","text":"Dated: TRUELINK, INC."},{"id":"p0099","text":"--------------------------"},{"id":"p0100","text":"By ------------------------------------- Title:"},{"id":"p0101","text":"Dated: MORTGAGE LOGIC.COM, INC. --------------------------"},{"id":"p0102","text":"By ------------------------------------- Title:"},{"id":"p0103","text":"-10- 11"},{"id":"p0104","text":"Exhibit \"A\""},{"id":"p0105","text":"Charges for Hosting Services"},{"id":"p0106","text":"[To be agreed to by and between TrueLink and Client prior to the Closing]"},{"id":"p0107","text":"-11- 12"},{"id":"p0108","text":"Exhibit \"B\""},{"id":"p0109","text":"Charges for Support Services"},{"id":"p0110","text":"[To be agreed to by and between TrueLink and client prior to the Closing]"}]}

input.summary: Add successor/M&A carve-out and reasonableness standard to assignment consent

content.text: All redlines validate. Submitting findings.

input.quote: IN NO EVENT SHALL TRUELINK'S LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO SECTION 3, 4, 7 AND 11 THIS AGREEMENT (OTHER THAN DUE TO A BREACH RESULTING FROM TRUELINK'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT) EXCEED THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD.
input.rationale: The cap is one-sided: only TrueLink's liability is limited (to 12 months' hosting/support compensation) and Client's liability — including under the broad Section 12(a) indemnity — is unlimited, which is walk-away territory. We made the 12-month cap mutual and added the standard uncapped carve-outs (confidentiality/data, indemnities, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement), confirming Client's fee obligations sit outside the cap.

input.quote: TrueLink shall indemnify and hold Client harmless, its affiliates, directors, officers, employees, agents and licensors harmless from and against all claims, actions, expenses, losses, and liabilities, including reasonable attorneys' fees, arising from or relating to any
input.rationale: TrueLink's indemnity is limited to its own breach of the Agreement, with no third-party IP infringement indemnity for the Interface (and no non-infringement warranty to support one), while Client's indemnity in Section 12(a) is very broad. That fails the fallback, so we added the standard vendor indemnity for infringement, breach of law, unauthorised access to Client data and gross negligence/wilful misconduct.

input.quote: Client is not obligated to utilize the License and is free to acquire, develop, license or otherwise utilize any other hardware, software system, design, formula, procedure or trade secret to provide software and services similar to the ones provided by TrueLink hereunder
input.rationale: No non-compete or field-of-use restriction binds Client; Section 2(a) expressly preserves our freedom to build or buy competing software and services. We note Section 8(d) cross-refers to a separate "Non-Competition Agreement" governing Credit Data use — that document should be diligenced separately, but nothing in this agreement restricts our business.

input.quote: Subject to the foregoing, Client shall order TrueLink a credit report on each borrower for which an underwriting approval is requested through a System using the Interface.
input.rationale: The licence is non-exclusive and Section 2(a) confirms we may use alternative providers, so there is no sole-supplier obligation. The only tie-in is Section 3(i), which applies solely where we choose to route an underwriting request through the Interface, is confined to a single defined product (credit reports) and runs only with the 1-year term — within the fallback; noted rather than redlined.

input.quote: TrueLink agrees that the costs for any Hosting Services will not increase for a period of one year from the date of this Agreement and that rates charged for Hosting Services will not exceed that charged by TrueLink to any other party.
input.rationale: The only MFN runs in our favour — TrueLink must not charge us more than any other customer for Hosting Services. No MFN obligation burdens Client, so no redline; we keep this provision.

input.quote: Client shall not engage in the practice commonly known as "spamming" pursuant to the rights granted hereunder.
input.rationale: There is no non-solicitation or no-hire covenant binding Client anywhere in the agreement (the only "solicit" references concern unsolicited commercial e-mail), which matches our preferred position of no non-solicit.

input.quote: 14. TERMINATION. Subject to Section 4 hereof, TrueLink will continue to provide the requested Hosting Services and Support Services until the last day of the month following the month in which Client provides TrueLink with a written notice of its election to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: Client may terminate at will, effective at the end of the month following notice (roughly 30–60 days), with no early-termination fee, and TrueLink has no convenience right (its Section 13 rights are for-cause only) — at or near our preferred position. We note only that no pro-rata refund of prepaid fees is stated (fees are invoiced monthly) and that Section 13's cross-reference to "Section 12" should read Section 14.

input.quote: This Agreement shall renew automatically thereafter for successive one year periods until terminated pursuant to Section 12 herein or unless either Client or TrueLink deliver to the other written notice of intent not to renew no later than thirty (30) days prior to the end of said year.
input.rationale: Automatic 12-month renewals with a mutual 30-day non-renewal window meet our preferred structure. The absence of a vendor renewal reminder and of an express renewal price-uplift cap (Section 6 freezes hosting costs only for the first year) are noted rather than flagged.

input.rationale: California law with exclusive jurisdiction of California state/federal courts and no arbitration sits at our accepted fallback. We note only that the venue is TrueLink's home county (Client is in Orange County) — a point we could raise commercially, but not a playbook deviation.

input.quote: 15. ASSIGNMENT OR TRANSFER. Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
input.rationale: Consent is required for any assignment with only an affiliate carve-out — there is no successor/M&A carve-out and no reasonableness standard, so it fails the fallback and would let TrueLink block a sale of our business. We added the M&A/successor carve-out on notice and a "not unreasonably withheld" standard; helpfully, there is no vendor change-of-control termination right to delete.

input.quote: Client hereby grants to TrueLink the nonexclusive worldwide right and license to use, distribute, disseminate, license, resell, exploit, upload, display, copy and store Credit Data subject to the limitations set forth in and in accordance with the Non-Competition Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 8(d) hands TrueLink an unrestricted right to distribute, license, resell and exploit data originating with our borrowers, and the agreement nowhere confirms Client's retained ownership of its data and IP — directionally adverse under this rule. TrueLink keeping ownership of the Interface (Section 2(d)) is acceptable; we narrowed the Credit Data licence to service delivery and added a Client ownership/no-joint-ownership sentence.

input.quote: a. Grant. TrueLink hereby grants to Client a non-exclusive license to use the Interface in the ordinary course of its business of the origination, underwriting, processing and funding of consumer finance receivables in accordance with this Agreement.
input.rationale: The grant runs to Client alone: affiliates are not covered and there is no mechanism to add them, which fails the fallback even though the licence is not revocable at will (it runs with the term). We inserted affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf into the grant; successor transferability is addressed under ASSIGN rather than duplicated here.

input.quote: e. Access. Client will have access to Interface usage statistics and raw log files in real time via the Interface.
input.rationale: There is no audit, inspection or usage-verification right exercisable against Client, and no TrueLink access to Client systems; the only access and documentation rights run in our favour (Sections 3(e) and 6). Better than our preferred position, so no redline.

input.quote: Client will pay TrueLink's fees for requested Hosting Services and Support Services pursuant to the schedule of charges set forth on Exhibits "A" and "B" attached hereto, (but not less than $____ per month for the Hosting Services and $____ per month for Support Services).
input.rationale: No liquidated damages, penalty or termination-related minimum payment is imposed on Client; Client's only exposure is the monthly minimum fees while services are being provided, which is a commercial floor rather than a penalty (addressed under MINCOMMIT). Nothing to redline under this rule.

input.quote: EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY SET FORTH IN THIS AGREEMENT, TRUELINK DISCLAIMS ANY AND ALL EXPENSES WARRANTIES, WARRANTIES OF FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE AND IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY OR FOR ANY MATTER RELATING TO THE ACCURACY OR COMPLETENESS, OR TIMING OF TRANSMISSION OF ANY DATA SUBMITTED THROUGH THE INTERFACE OR TO OR FROM THE WEB SITE.
input.rationale: The only express TrueLink warranty is Y2K-specific (Section 9); there is no conformance-to-documentation warranty, no workmanlike-performance standard (Section 11's "same care as for its own operations" is not an industry standard) and no remedy, while the disclaimer strips everything else. That falls below the fallback, so we inserted the 90-day conformance and workmanlike warranties with a re-perform/repair/refund remedy, carved out of the disclaimer.

input.quote: 30. FORCE MAJEURE. TrueLink will be excused from delays in performing or from failing to perform its obligations under this Agreement to the extent the delays or failures result from causes beyond the reasonable control or TrueLink.
input.rationale: The agreement contains no insurance obligation at all, which is unacceptable for a vendor hosting our web site and processing borrower credit data. We inserted a short insurance section (CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, cyber 5M, certificates on request) after Section 30.

input.rationale: The only commitment is a monthly minimum fee for Hosting and Support Services during a 1-year term, and Client can exit that at will under Section 14 (effective end of the following month), so it sits within the fallback — no multi-year take-or-pay and no shortfall penalty. content.text:
All 18 rules reviewed and submitted. Summary:

**Deviations redlined (8)**
- **LOL-CAP** (critical): cap protects TrueLink only; Client uncapped. Made mutual at 12 months' fees with uncapped Excluded Claims and fees carve-out.
- **INDEMN** (critical): vendor indemnity covers only its own breach — no third-party IP infringement cover. Added the standard vendor indemnity.
- **IP** (critical): §8(d) lets TrueLink distribute/license/resell/exploit Credit Data; no Client ownership statement. Narrowed to service delivery and added retained-ownership sentence.
- **ASSIGN**: consent gate with affiliate-only carve-out; added M&A/successor carve-out and reasonableness standard.
- **LICENSE**: grant excludes affiliates/contractors with no path to add; inserted them.
- **WARRANTY**: only a Y2K warranty behind a broad disclaimer; added workmanlike + 90-day conformance warranty with remedy.
- **TRANSITION**: no data return or exit assistance; inserted 6-month assistance, 30-day export, certified deletion.
- **INSURANCE** (missing): no insurance clause for a hosting vendor handling credit data; inserted new §31.

**Compliant / no redline (10)**: NONCOMPETE (§2(a) preserves our freedom — note the separate Non-Competition Agreement needs diligence), EXCLUSIVITY (narrow §3(i) tie-in only), MFN (runs in our favour), NOSOLICIT (none), T4C (Client at-will exit, no vendor convenience right), RENEWAL (12-month renewals, 30-day window), GOVLAW (California law/courts — fallback), AUDIT (no audit right against us), LD (none payable by us), MINCOMMIT (monthly minimum exitable at will; blanks must be completed).
